scope: Read-only source/schema audit; no production queries or ingestion performed by this audit

findings.fact: Both ingestion providers request90days; canonical scoring reads180days. Existing ingestion does not emit per-symbol180day coverage.
sync_sec keeps aggregate counts and operation=submissions; insider failures become empty lists before aggregate success. Run success does not distinguish zero, failed, capped or omitted issuers.

ir_events stores positive event dates and metadata with unique(source_code,external_id), no ingestion run linkage or population/window completion. Old events plus historical runs cannot independently prove complete180day coverage or verifiedzero.
Finnhub uses from without bounded to/coverage receipt and returns empty on malformed data. EODHD default five pages can stop on failure/cap without completion proof.
Empty FMP grades is UNKNOWN; recognizing symbol in EODHD does not prove FMP coverage. Nonempty old rows without eligible dated rows retain unknown window source_at.

consequence: Current tracked ingestion cannot itself substantiate the required ten READY assessments under RC4. An external genuine pre-existing per-symbol180day receipt must be independently verified if offered; this audit cannot assert facts about unexamined private artifacts. No synthetic receipt, relaxed gate or fabricated zero is permitted.

smallest_proposed_change_code_only.mode: Explicit audited180day sync_sec evidence mode; retain default90day behavior and Finnhub then EODHD fallback selection.
smallest_proposed_change_code_only.storage: Existing ingestion metadata JSONB or private hashed sidecar with audited linkage; no schema migration required by this proposal.
smallest_proposed_change_code_only.complete_only_if: Known symbol/window/population, successful complete traversal, no unresolved truncation or parsing loss, persisted events readback matches selected source; otherwise PARTIAL or UNKNOWN.
smallest_proposed_change_code_only.authorization: No execution, provider calls or database writes included; requires reviewed implementation and owner-authorized ingestion.
